title: الأربعين النووية
author: أبو زكريا يحيى بن شرف النووي
structure_summary: flat collection: front matter (title page, lines 1-36) → 42 numbered hadith units (lines 37-700) → back-matter index (الفهرس, lines 701-790). No chapters or sections. Each unit: heading + body (isnad+matn) + attribution (رواه…) + editor footnotes (takhrij/gharib). Unit numbers read from inline isnad markers (0.95) or page-top tokens (0.7). Page boundaries unknown (no auxiliary source). OCR noise: running headers, page numbers, displaced headings/footnotes, garbled glyphs.
notes: No auxiliary input (PDF/DOCX/images) available; page model empty and recorded as issue_005.
Numbering systems mixed in source: Arabic-Indic (٢٤٥), Persian (۲۴۵), ASCII (34). Treated as equivalent; original digits preserved.
Footnotes frequently read by the OCR after the next unit's heading; each reassigned to its logical owner and cross-referenced via foreign_spans (issue_007).
